description: Fast news scan on a topic: up to 5 ranked recent items (or the number you ask for), each with its publication date and a source link. Name a window such as "last 7 days" to restrict it; with no window it ranks newest first. If too few sources can be fetched or no item qualifies, it returns NO QUALIFYING RESULTS with the sources it searched, and your payment is refunded (USDC goes back to the paying wallet; see refund_state at /v1/proofs/settlement/<tx>). Settlement proof: ProofOfSettledOutcome. The quick tier below research.topic-deep-researcher. (x402: $0.02 USDC per call)
name: research.topic-news-scanner
